evals.prompt: Build a Copilot Studio agent for our HR department that answers employee questions about leave policies using our SharePoint knowledge base.
evals.expected_output: Agent designs a proper agent with SharePoint knowledge source, fallback topic, escalation path, and authentication.
expectations: Agent is created inside a solution (solution-aware)
SharePoint knowledge source is configured with specific site URLs
Generative answers are enabled with content moderation set to medium or high
Fallback/no-answer topic includes escalation to human agent
Authentication is configured (Entra ID for internal employees)
Adversarial testing is mentioned or performed

evals.prompt: We need three agents: one for HR, one for IT, and one for Finance. They should be able to hand off between each other.
evals.expected_output: Agent designs a multi-agent orchestration topology with embedded or connected agents.
expectations: Recommends a multi-agent topology (hub-and-spoke or mesh)
Explains embedded agents vs connected agents vs A2A protocol
Each domain agent has its own knowledge sources scoped appropriately
Handoff between agents preserves conversation context
ALM strategy accounts for multiple agent solutions
Security boundaries between agents are defined
